admission.justification: Binds revision-head selection to retained revisions only: order, presence and guessed succession never elect a head.

alternatives.option: Heads are the retained revisions of the union; one text record holds one revision (rule 3); a further revision outside the union states only what was read.
alternatives.reason: Successor edges left with the authored lineage; sorted identity strings and stream position are not authorship and must not elect heads.

alternatives.option: Elect heads from sorted order or stream presence when no edge is recorded.
alternatives.reason: Guesses a winner the authors never recorded, which is exactly the denial the head rule exists to prevent.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The rejected shape gains a governed producer and contract.

consequences: Future selection work keeps the retained-population rule and the retraction display for unrecorded pairings.
context: MIK-R74 rule 3: single-revision text records with no predecessor edge; revision selection, line display and one-sided statements all read heads from what is retained.
